root_cause.text: The `struct iw_point` on 64-bit architectures contains uninitialized padding bytes (a 32-bit hole) that are not zeroed when copying from the compat `compat_iw_point` structure, leading to disclosure of kernel stack memory to user space.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "struct iw_point has a 32bit hole on 64bit arches. Make sure to zero the structure to avoid disclosing 32bits of kernel data to user space." The patch adds `memset(&iwp, 0, sizeof(iwp));` before setting the fields in `compat_standard_call()` (wext-core.c) and `compat_private_call()` (wext-priv.c).
